positiveIntegral_coe:
theorem positiveIntegral_coe (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    positiveIntegral μ (fun ω => (f ω : EReal)) = ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (f ω) ∂μ
negativeIntegral_coe:
theorem negativeIntegral_coe (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    negativeIntegral μ (fun ω => (f ω : EReal)) = ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (-f ω) ∂μ
positiveIntegral_coe_ne_top:
theorem positiveIntegral_coe_ne_top (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    positiveIntegral μ (fun ω => (f ω : EReal)) ≠ ∞
negativeIntegral_coe_ne_top:
theorem negativeIntegral_coe_ne_top (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    negativeIntegral μ (fun ω => (f ω : EReal)) ≠ ∞
signedExpectation_coe_integrable:
theorem signedExpectation_coe_integrable (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    signedExpectation μ (fun ω => (f ω : EReal)) = ((∫ ω, f ω ∂μ : ℝ) : EReal)
signedExpectation_of_nonneg:
theorem signedExpectation_of_nonneg (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → EReal)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ f ω) :
    signedExpectation μ f = (positiveIntegral μ f : EReal)
signedExpectation_eq_top:
theorem signedExpectation_eq_top (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → EReal)
    (hp : positiveIntegral μ f = ∞) (hn : negativeIntegral μ f ≠ ∞) :
    signedExpectation μ f = ⊤
